paragraphs.text: Jamuraa (jah-moo-rah ) refers to a supercontinent on Dominaria . It was the setting for the Mirage , Visions and Prophecy expansions and the novels of Legends Cycle I .

Jamuraa is the largest of the continents on Dominaria . It is located about two thousand miles south of Corondor . Far to the northeast of it lies Shiv , and southeast lies Caliman . Jamuraa extends for approximately 4,000 miles. The north of its western subcontinent is occupied by two nations: the religious state of Femeref , and the trading province of the Suq'Ata Empire . The militaristic kingdom of Zhalfir , now its own plane separate from Dominaria, also used to lie here, west of the two other states. South-east lies the Great Desert , which is controlled by the Suq'Ata Empire and the reptilian humanoids known as the Viashino . The southern part of the subcontinent is occupied by the Blue Mountains , the forested regions of Arboria and Scarwood , and the Sukurvian Desert , where lie the city-states of Bryce , Tirras , and Palmyra .

This western subcontinent is linked to another landmass by an isthmus barely ten leagues wide. The eastern subcontinent is covered by a huge desert, controlled by people descended from immigrants from Rabiah . North and east lies yet another subcontinent containing the Kipamu City States , the Vintara Forest , and the marsh of Nakaya .

This region remained relatively stable for millennia, being untouched by the Brothers' War , discovering the use of magic very early (possibly before any other region) and using it to keep the Ice Age from affecting it.

Johan , Tyrant of Tirras and Emperor of the Northern Realms, was a powerful but evil mage who tried to conquer the Jamuraan western continent. He entered into direct conflict with the city-states of Jamuraa, led by Hazezon Tamar and the Robaran Mercenaries . After a first defeat against the city-states, his second large-scale attempt consisted of trying to conquer the Sukurvian Desert to enslave the cat warrior tribes living there, which would lead them to ally with the humans to ultimately defeat Johan .

After he settled on Jamuraa, the wizard Mangara created a peace agreement between the rivaling nations. When Femeref and Zhalfir could not agree on a border, Mangara created a buffer zone near the Unyaro Jungle . To police this zone, he summoned a large contingent of Quirion elves from his home continent of Corondor . The creation of peace with Suq'Ata was trickier but resulted eventually in a trade agreement. Within a century Mangara's Harmony created a new age of enlightenment.

Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara. At first, Kaervek was aided by the jungle-dwelling sorceress Jolrael due to deceiving her. During the Mirage Wars the country was plundered by Kaervek's troops, and plagued by the Nightstalkers of Urborg .

During the Prophecy War , Jamuraa was subject to a Keldon invasion right before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria . After the later war, the planeswalker Teferi decided to save thew region of Zhalfir from further strife, and phased it out .

In Future Sight when Shiv and Zhalfir needed to be phased back in, there were complications with the time rifts , and as a result, Jeska Planeswalker sealed the rift before Zhalfir could be phased back in, thereby effectively erasing the country from existence in Dominaria . Much of Suq'Ata couldn't be saved either. During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Zhalfir would become its own plane , leaving Jamuraa without its former glory.
The Kukemssa Sea - the sea separating Jamuraa from the Domains and the Burning Isles Buleusi Bay - the new coastline bordering the Zhalfirin void
Ekundu Mountains - the central mountains separating Suq'Ata and Femeref

Femeref - a strong religious state The Kitu Mountains - a small range in central Femeref Nyomba - hometown of the sorcerer Waffa Sewa - a coastal town near the Zhalfirin Void. Terorq - a mining-city populated by Ekundu dwarves. Tulumai - the capital of Femeref. Located at a deep inland bay that leads south to the Jaema Sea .
The Karoo - the dry grasslands east of Suq'Ata, bordering the Great Desert

The Jaema Sea - formerly a sea along Zhalfir the Jaema is now the sea south of Femeref . It runs from the Kukemssa Sea along the coast of Femeref as a warm, shallow body of water. Further to the south the sea is deeper, colder and wilder. This is where the sea borders the Storm Coast and Buzzard's Bay .
The Jotoka Mountains - the range east of Femeref separating it from the Great Desert
The Maumiwu Wastes - the barrens between the Great Desert and the Jaema Sea
The Sacred Mesa - home to pegasi
Suq'Ata - a powerful merchant nation Amiqat - the capital of Suq'Ata Wayraqa - a trade city on the coast
Albatross Alley - A stretch of sea that defines the northern border of the volcanic islands south of Jamuraa.
Arboria - Dense woodlands with a dark history

The Blue Mountains - the central mountain range separating the subcontinent into a northwestern and a southeastern part The Flint Mountains — A lesser mountain ridge near Sukurvia , possibly an arm of the Blue Mountains north of Palmyra , as its high passes are close enough for Palmyrans to climb them. The Tirran Mountains - a lesser ridge of Mountains north of Tirras, bordering the Sukurvian desert. It is here that the fortress of Krieghelm sits, overlooking the city in the foothills below. The Tirran Mountains are likely a smaller arm of the Blue Mountains . The Northern Realms - the realms along the Tirran Mountains Aerath - the lands of berserkers who fled the destruction of their original island home Tirras - a trade city Bald Point - a former forest north of Tirras, cut down to make Johan 's airships. Krieghelm - the fortress of Johan
The Great Wall - a huge wall cutting off the lands of Sukurvia from the western shores beyond.
The Horn of Plenty - a cape between the Bay of Shaibara and the Bight of Ishan
Scarwood - a large forest, home to catfolk Dark Heart of the Wood - a precious enchantment lingering in the middle of Scarwood The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale - an ancient structure of prophecy

The Craggy Coast The Bay of Pearls - a bay that lies at the mouth of the River Toloron and harbors the city of Bryce . Bryce - a port city in the Bay of Pearls The Bay of Shaibara - a bay to the south of Scarwood The Shaibara Islands - islands on the mouth of the bay Shaibara - a coastal city ruled by a sultan. It is located across the Bay of Shaibara from the Horn of Plenty, and lies south of the Scarwood . Yerkoy - a coastal city on the Bay of Shaibara Enez - a coastal city by the Great Wall Fysmatan - a coastal city-state Kalan - a city on the coast Lucrezia - a city on the coast, rival of Fysmatan

Madara - a former empire The Edemi Islands - an archipelago of smaller islands Argenti - a green island Lisu - capital city of Argenti The Sylvan Library - a mystical place of forest magic Kusho - an island nation Kusho Bay - the island approach is a reef passage riddled with rapdily-growing coral Shima Pond - a small lake of healing powers The Gitte-Yatay Mountains - a mountain range in the eastern part of Madara Hakkan Delta - the delta of Hakkan River Pelada - a fishing port Sekana - a town on the coast The Suido River - a river flowing from the mountains and splitting into three streams, formerly ran past Dark's Keep . The Talon Gates - spires of rock jutting from the sea Umezawa Manor - the manor house of Clan Umezawa
The Haunted Coast - a dark land east of the Great Desert Shimia - origin of nightstalkers and specters
Jamuraan Sea - the supercontinent's large mediterranean sea The Thunder Islands - islands in the Jamuraan Sea north of Shimia.
Kenlefia - a city of religious people led by shamans of the Old Way
The Magnetic Mountain - a single mountain on a barren plain north of Sukurvia , which has a strong pull on any piece of iron

The Sea of Serenity - the sea south of the whole subcontinent. The Bight of Ishan - a bight by the Onyx Bridge Bitter Reef - a place where powerstones have been found The Cocobar Islands - an archipelago Koltos - an island rumored to be cursed Alchor's Tomb - a former prison for an Infernal Medusa Sarixa - a seaport where adventurers and guides can be recruited Dangerous Shoals - a place where powerstones have been found Fear Island - once attacked by King Gaynor , but its defenses crushed his navy. The Isles of the Cyclopes - an archipelago The Isles of the Scarabs - an archipelago The Red Agates - small islands off the coast Unawanna - a tropical volcanic island

The Storm Coast - the western coast of Jamuraa Buzzard's Bay - a huge bay of treacherous, jagged rocks. Amrou Haven - a ruin, formerly home to the kithkin Witch's Weir - the southern arm of the bay Buzzard's Bay port - a port town named after the bay Seafarer's Quay - famously safe deepwater harbor Adventurers' Guildhouse - a popular tavern, inn and questing hub. Fulmart's Fort - a city on the shore Goat's Walk - the shore on the south side of the weir. Cape Hope - the cape marking the southern edge of Buzzard's Bay Garaboss - a port town on the cape Sheep's Head - a bald knob marking the border between the Storm Coast and the Craggy Coast

Sukurvia - a large, harsh desert that inhibits passage between Scarwood and the Blue Mountains Hooraree - one of the cat warrior oases Khyyiani - one of the cat warrior oases Sulaki - one of the cat warrior oases The Sunken Sea - an underground sea beneath the desert that fed into the oases and the lake of Johan's Joy. Vacar Slab - an execution site of the Old Way, located deep into the desert
The River Toloron - a river running from the Blue Mountains to the Bay of Pearls Palmyra - a city of pirates.
The Western Wastes - a barren land east of the Great Wall and west of the Toloron river

The western subcontinent is linked to the south-eastern continent by the Onyx Bridge , an isthmus barely ten leagues wide that divides the Jamuraan Sea in the north from the Bight of Ishan to the south.
Gallidi , a port city controlling trade between the subcontinents.
Karakas - a peninsula, location of a legendarily peaceful city.
The Tivan Desert - Dominaria's largest desert.

The Mayar Mountains - the long chain of mountains south of the Tivan Desert . They effectively wall off the desert from the humidity of the Sea of Serenity , creating a band of green forest along the coast to the south, in sharp contrast to the extremely dry conditions to the north.
A small jungle, home to Eumidians and Nekoru .

The Jamuraan Sea , also known as the Midmercian Sea , is surrounded by the three Jamuraan subcontinents. There are many islands within this sea, though none have been named. In 3335 AR, Gallidi was the only port on this dangerous sea, visited only by sailors from Corondor to the north.
The Clinging Bogs - a marsh infested with thorns and razor vines.
The North Jamuraan Bight - the curved northern coastline

The Kipamu League - an alliance of city-states Arsenal City - a coastal city-state, site of a battle against the Keldons during the Prophecy War . Kinymu - an inland city-state Kitani - a shipping port
Nakaya - an emormous swampy region inhabited by shades and snakes
Vintara - a thickly overgrown forest inhabited by elephants and turtles
Zerapa - mountain range and nation located east of the Ki'pamu City States , settled by minotaurs .
Dahoma - a city trading copper and tin for grain from Gallidi by way of traders from Corondor . Likely located somewhere between Corondor and the Onyx Bridge .
Dunance - famous for its traders, who raided when given the chance.
El Kadiz Creek - somewhere where Tor Wauki the Elder shot down Al-abara 's brother from his Flying Carpet .
Gulatto Meisha (during Thran times) During his exile, Yawgmoth poisoned the human tribes of Gulatto Meisha.
Isles of the Cyclopes - islands that Johan had ambitions on conquering.
Matopi - a muddy region notorious for its golems .

Oryn Deeps - a subterranean dwarven empire in the mountains of Jamuraa. It existed at the time of the Thran . During his exile, Yawgmoth cured its citizens of a disease called black-cough and started a rebellion among the dwarves.
Perth - a location that was specifically unknown to Adira Strongheart , so likely not on the Craggy Coast .
Jamuraa has produced some interesting characters.
Afari , author of the Tales of Jamuraa
